annotations.text:
Depth comes from tokens the system already ships and the messages screen never used:

--fw-shadow-card carries an inset lit top edge — design-tokens.css calls it "the 'lit from above' tell of a premium surface".

--fw-gradient-canvas is a radial wash over a linear one, so the page has a light source instead of a flat fill.

Header, day chip and composer are glass: rgb(244 232 210 / 0.74) at blur 22px, saturate 190% — the --fw-glass-* family, with the warm specular rim above and the deeper warm edge below that the token comments describe as "more depth".

Not the retired glass-* CLASSES, which design-system.md bans.
Own bubbles cast a GREEN ambient rather than a grey one, so their shadow belongs to their colour. Same for the send button and the primary CTA.

The five reactions are the app's own closed set, from src/lib/golf/message-reactions.ts — not a picker I invented.

In a nine-person group this is the point: one tap instead of nine "got it" messages.

Group details. The faces are real members — use-golf-group-avatars.ts already batches them for the inbox, so the same resolution serves this.

No read receipt anywhere in a group: the hook can only see ONE arbitrary member's last_read_at, so "Read" would claim the group when one person looked.
